title: Learnings (append-only brand log)
description: Brand-wide append-only learnings log. Singleton brands/{slug}/learnings.json. Entries by kind (test_result, workaround, compliance, observation, decision_trace, hypothesis_validated, pattern_promoted). v1.0 baseline shipped v2.58. Used by learn-from-session + capture-learning + brief-day Trigger pattern detection.

_changelog.1.2: Reconciliation 3-dialectes (additif pur). entries[].items gagne: reasoning, date(alias YYYY-MM-DD), scope, platform, type(alias classif), category, tags, status, genericity, see_also, confidence, promoted_to, promoted_date. source enum etendu (union canon + capture-learning). cross_refs gagne mechanism_refs[]+benefit_refs[]. `kind` reste l'autorite de classification (type=alias tolere). `created_at` reste l'autorite temporelle (date=alias tolere, validate lit date puis fallback created_at). Aucun champ rendu required: brands pre-v1.2 valident toujours. Aligne le contrat sur ce que capture-learning/learn-from-session/promote-learning ecrivent reellement.
_changelog.1.1: v2.63 refactor ontologie pure additif · entries[].cross_refs.pain_point_ids[] + objection_ids[] arrays ajoutés (cross-refs canonical vers pain_points/{PNT-NN}.json + objections/{OBJ-NN}.json top-level collections v2.63). Preserve friction_ids[] + angle_ids[] + audience_slugs[] + product_slugs[] + brief_ids[] + creative_ids[] existants. Permet pattern detection cross-entity (learn-from-session Trigger 8) sur ontologie 3 collections sub-tensions séparées. Backward compat strict additif.
_changelog.1.0: v2.58 baseline. Append-only entries with kind/fact/created_at/source. Validation_status per entry. Cross_refs canonical vers other entities (angles, audiences, products, frictions, briefs).

promoted_to_canon_count.description: Count entries cross-brand validées promues canon copy

entries.description: Append-only · jamais modifier, jamais supprimer. Invalidation = nouvelle entrée flag superseded_by sur l'ancienne id.

cross_refs.description: Références canon vers autres entités brand. Permet pattern detection cross-entity (Trigger 8 brief-day). v1.1 ajoute pain_point_ids[] + objection_ids[] cross-refs vers top-level collections v2.63.

pain_point_ids.description: v1.1 additif · cross-refs canonical vers pain_points/{PNT-NN}.json top-level collection v2.63.

objection_ids.description: v1.1 additif · cross-refs canonical vers objections/{OBJ-NN}.json top-level collection v2.63.

mechanism_refs.description: v1.2 additif · ponts vers mecanismes produit (spec.mechanisms[].mechanism_id ou label). Utilise par _EXAMPLE patterns creative.

benefit_refs.description: v1.2 additif · ponts vers benefices (spec.benefits[].benefit_id ou label). Utilise par _EXAMPLE patterns CTA.

superseded_by.description: Si remplacée par LRN-NNNN plus récent, référence stockée ici. Append-only enforcement.

promoted_canon_path.description: Si promoted_to_canon=true · path canon copy promotion (e.g. resources/canon/copy/hooks/{tool}.json)

source.description: v1.2 union des 2 dialectes · canon (operator/agent/skill_output/test_capture) + capture-learning (test/client_call/platform_docs/observation). Additif pur.

reasoning.description: v1.2 additif · Decision Trace (D#308) · le WHY derriere le fact. capture-learning + learn-from-session l'exigent MANDATORY non-vide a l'ecriture. Non-required au schema pour backward-compat des entries pre-v1.2.

scope.description: v1.2 additif · portee d'application (capture-learning + validate Check 11c index).

platform.description: v1.2 additif · meta|shopify|google|ga4|klaviyo|... requis si scope=platform.

type.description: v1.2 additif · alias de classification dialecte-skills (capture-learning). `kind` reste l'autorite canon 9-enum ; `type` est tolere pour ne pas casser les skills existants.

category.description: v1.2 additif · classe libre (ex: system_friction de learn-from-session HR runtime patterns).

tags.description: v1.2 additif · tags d'inference (capture-learning + validate + promote-learning marqueur promoted:).

status.description: v1.2 additif · cycle de vie du learning (distinct de validation_status qui est le cycle de test). Ecrit par capture-learning a la creation (active) et par validate Check 12b (superseded/archived).

genericity.description: v1.2 additif · portee de generalisation (capture-learning + validate Check 12b cross-brand detection + promote-learning Step 2).

see_also.description: v1.2 additif · pointeurs vers learnings voisins (dedup learn-from-session).

confidence.description: v1.2 additif · confidence du pattern (utilise par _EXAMPLE + learn-from-session Trigger 9 gate >=0.7).

promoted_to.description: v1.2 additif · path resources/ KB partagee si promu via promote-learning (distinct de promoted_canon_path qui vise resources/canon/copy/).

promoted_date.description: v1.2 additif · date de promotion KB partagee (promote-learning Step 5).

date.description: v1.2 additif · alias temporel court (YYYY-MM-DD) ecrit par les skills. `created_at` (date-time) reste l'autorite canon ; validate Check 10 lit `date` en priorite avec fallback created_at.
